deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the stained slice through a tumour 'illustrates this', linking it back to explanting a tumour. The text does not link the slide to explanting the tumour; it merely states what the slide shows.

considerations.sourcePassage: Primary cells really don't grow in culture.
considerations.reason: The word 'really' functions here as conversational emphasis rather than a scientific hedge, so rendering the statement as 'Primary cells do not grow in culture' is an acceptable stylistic simplification.
